You are a mathematics expert solving competition-level problems. 
Solve the problem step by step, showing your work clearly.
At the end, provide your final answer in the format:
Answer: <your_answer>

Where <your_answer> is the numerical or mathematical answer to the problem.

How many packs of glue sticks does Mr. Jackson need to buy so every student can have 2 glue sticks? Mr. Jackson’s fourth-grade class has 27 students. Mr. Jackson wants to give each student 2 glue sticks. The glue sticks come in packs of 8. Mr. Jackson can only buy whole packs and expects to have some extra glue sticks left over.
